target.title: refactor(gateway): consolidate TypeScript WebSocket clients
target.body:
Closes #105963

## What Problem This Solves

The Node runtime and Control UI maintained separate implementations of the same Gateway WebSocket protocol lifecycle. That duplicated handshake, request/response/event dispatch, reconnect, timeout, and sequence-gap behavior, making fixes easy to apply to only one client.

## Why This Change Was Made

This introduces one browser-safe protocol lifecycle engine in `@openclaw/gateway-client`, with thin Node and browser adapters that retain their transport-specific policy. The Node adapter keeps `ws`, TLS/origin/proxy, device-auth, and watchdog behavior; the Control UI keeps native `WebSocket`, WebCrypto/storage auth, mixed-content enforcement, its existing 800ms/1.7x/15s reconnect policy, timing telemetry, and UI error surfaces.

The Control UI now imports the browser entrypoint instead of implementing a second protocol stack or deep-importing Gateway protocol source files. The branch is net -2 lines and adds no compatibility shim or user-visible behavior change.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible change. Control UI connect, disconnect banner, reconnect timing, authentication failures, and recovery behavior remain the same, while future Gateway client fixes have one canonical lifecycle implementation.

## Evidence

- Exact final head `218a2ae34f12213b436d6a1de3a13a76bfe074a7`; CI is running. [Run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29241110541)
- Gateway package: 18/18 tests passed on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxdad0r03wpsjknyre3vbpvn`. [Run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29236520870)
- Core Gateway client: 189/189 tests passed on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxdag4hd3qdnyq67x50dzrqx`. [Run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29236622473)
- Control UI Gateway/store: 52/52 tests passed on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxdakbf5e21b2ejncmjdseqm`. [Run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29236720892)
- Full Control UI suite: 3,757/3,757 tests passed on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxdbvwwmcbhdsksprh4ympxa`. [Run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29238064488)
- Production build passed on Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxdaqgv5dgeg1044r0rbdmxa`. [Run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29236863929)
- Real Chromium Control UI connected to an actual loopback Gateway, showed the reconnect banner after shutdown, restored ready state after restart, and made three WebSocket attempts.
- Source-blind behavior validation passed all contract clauses at confidence 0.9.
- Fresh structured autoreviews of the final CI and net-negative cleanup deltas reported no actionable findings; full source-equivalent review was clean before those reviewed deltas.
